title: Exotic Sweet Egyptian Milk Pudding
description: A tender and sweet Egyptian dessert made with sweetened condensed milk, perfect for a date night, served in a stone bowl dolsot.
instructions: Combine the sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, and cornstarch in a medium saucepan and whisk until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the rose water and vanilla extract.
Pour the pudding mixture into the stone bowl dolsot.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Sprinkle the chopped pistachios over the top of the pudding.
Drizzle the honey over the pistachios.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional pistachios if desired.
